about: The Tutor's tools for agents (Agent Link's tool-data format).

tutor_point.description: Point at FreeCAD's controls for the person: numbered rings and a callout over the window; faces and edges lit in 3D. Never moves the cursor, opens a menu or switches workbench. targets (≤6): {cmd: "PartDesign_Pad"}, {menu: ["Part Design", "Pad"]}, {wb: "PartDesignWorkbench"}, {task: "Length" | {name, label, button}}, {tree: "Sketch"}, {face: {normal: [0,0,1], largest: true}, of}, {edge: {near: [x,y,z]}, of} (of beside the query), {sub: "Face6", of}, {dock: "Report view"}, {view: "3d"}. Replaces earlier highlights unless clear: false; no targets clears. Says why any target is not shown.
